install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
export USER="${USER:-root}"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

arch="$(uname -m)"
case "$arch" in
  x86_64) march="amd64" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) march="arm64" ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: unsupported architecture ($arch)" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

echo "==> Installing MinIO Client (mc) for linux-${march}"

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apt-get update
  apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ca-certificates curl
elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dnf install -y ca-certificates curl
elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl
elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pacman -Sy --noconfirm ca-certificates curl
fi

workdir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/mc-install.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$workdir"' EXIT
cd "$workdir"

curl -fsSLo mc "https://dl.min.io/client/mc/release/linux-${march}/mc"
chmod +x mc
install -m 0755 mc /usr/local/bin/mc

echo "==> Verifying installation"
mc --version
echo "==> MinIO Client installed at $(command -v mc)"
uninstall_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
echo "==> Removing MinIO Client (mc)"
rm -f /usr/local/bin/mc
echo "==> mc removed"
